overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long ALAB Daily ETF (LABX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Astera Labs Inc. stock LABX was launched on Aug 11, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
